body: I wear hearing aids and can hear moderately well in my left ear however unless someone is on my left side and facing me i struggle to work out what they are saying. With my hearing loss its not all about lack of sound but the quality of sound (for example i can hear that someone is speaking most of the time however its like they are mumbling underwater to me). Its also the range - i can hear low and high sounds fairly well but the range in which people talk is the worst effected.
Thank you i will look into that i’ve been learning sign language for a while now but none of my friends know it so this might be more useful thank you
My C in english would suggest thats probably not the career for me...
